in_sanskrit.name: Hiren
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the mind, intelligence
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hiren एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Hiren is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hīrany', meaning 'golden'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Indra, who is believed to possess immense wisdom and intelligence. Hiren is a name for a boy who is considered to be the lord of his own mind and possesses great intelligence and wisdom.
